headline: Finance company mortgage lending surges 30% post-insurance scheme
caption: Big changes in how Kiwis are borrowing! Since the new Depositor Compensation Scheme launched, residential mortgage lending through finance companies has jumped over 30%. If you're exploring your lending options or thinking about refinancing, this shift shows there's more competition and choice in the market — which could work in your favour. Let's chat about what this means for your property goals! 🏡
original_title: Residential mortgage lending by finance companies up over 30% since deposit insurance launch
